helpModal.title: How to use the modeling editor
helpModal.intro: Start with the six core interactions below. The editor keeps controls close to the canvas so you can stay focused on the model.
helpModal.refineDescription: Once the structure is in place, use these interactions to arrange, correct, and reuse parts of your diagram.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work while the canvas has focus. Browser shortcuts keep working when focus is outside the editor or in an explanation field.

createElement.title: Add elements
createElement.text: Drag an element from the palette onto the canvas. On a touch device, select it in the palette and then tap its position on the canvas.

createRelationship.title: Connect elements
createRelationship.text: Select the source element to reveal its connection handles, then drag from a handle to the target element. Release when the target handle is highlighted.

updateElement.title: Edit details
updateElement.text: Double-click an element or relationship to open its editor. Update its name, type, content, and other available properties, then close the popover to continue.

deleteElement.title: Remove items
deleteElement.text: Select one or more elements or relationships, then press Delete or Backspace.

moveElement.title: Arrange the diagram
moveElement.text: Drag elements into place, or select them and use the arrow keys for precise adjustments. Pan the canvas to make room as the diagram grows.

resizeElement.title: Resize elements
resizeElement.text: Select an element and drag one of its resize handles. Keep labels readable and leave enough space for relationships.

reconnectRelationship.title: Reconnect relationships
reconnectRelationship.text: Select a relationship, then drag either endpoint to a different connection handle.

select.title: Work with a selection
select.text: Hold Shift while selecting to build a multi-selection. Use the platform shortcut shown in the Keyboard shortcuts tab to select everything.

duplicate.title: Reuse existing elements
duplicate.text: Copy and paste a selection to duplicate it with its properties. The Keyboard shortcuts tab shows the correct keys for your platform.

undo.title: Recover from mistakes
undo.text: Undo or redo recent changes at any time. You can find both platform-specific key combinations in the Keyboard shortcuts tab.
